title: openEHR building blocks workshop
description:
A paper building-block workshop on openEHR template modelling. Participants build the Nursing Admission Assessment template from printed archetype plates and building blocks, then author a new archetype (Inpatient admission details) with write-on blocks. No computers or internet are needed on the day.

Contains print-ready participant and facilitator handouts, the CKM desk, A0 baseplates, an offline drag-and-drop demo page, the archetypes and templates used, and the generator that builds all materials. Online demo: sophiedkk.github.io/datapoort-workshop.

Adapted from the openEHR workshop by Ian McNicoll (freshEHR), with the additions the Hanze made for the EHRCON26 version.
